items.title: HUBB Q3 deep dive: Data center strength offsets utility softness, capacity investments shape outlook
items.summary: Electrical and electronic products company Hubbell (NYSE:HUBB) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 24.6% year on year to $1.87 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.91 per share was 2.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 5 revealing analyst questions from Hubbell’s Q3 earnings call
items.summary: Hubbell’s third quarter was marked by revenue and adjusted profit surpassing Wall Street expectations, but the market reacted negatively, reflecting concerns about underlying trends. Management attributed the quarter’s growth to exceptional demand for its Electrical Solutions segment—particularly from data center infrastructure, which saw sales increase over 80% year-on-year.
